description: This file contains an Android Activity class that demonstrates the use of default layout transition animations in a GridLayout. It includes UI setup for adding and removing buttons dynamically, with transitions animated automatically.

classes.name: LayoutAnimationsByDefault
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates transition animations for layout changes (adding/removing buttons) in a GridLayout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets up button click handlers for adding and removing buttons in the grid layout.
